<article title="Warranty claims">
Fernwood gear is covered against defects in materials and workmanship for two years from delivery. Zippers, seams, buckles, and waterproof coatings are covered; normal wear, abrasion, and damage from misuse are not.

To start a claim, send us your order number, a description of the problem, and two photos showing the defect. We reply within two business days with a repair, replacement, or store credit decision.

Repairs are free and take two to three weeks including shipping. If we replace an item that is no longer made, we offer the closest current model or store credit for the original price.

</article>

Customer first name: Selma
<request>
safe to use?
my harness took a hard fall last weekend. it looks fine. can i keep climbing on it or is it a warranty thing?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Selma,

Thanks for reaching out. Our warranty article covers defects in materials and workmanship for two years from delivery, but it does not cover damage from misuse, and it doesn't address whether gear is safe to use after a fall. We can't advise on that from here, so a specialist will follow up with you.

If you'd like to start a warranty claim in the meantime, send us your order number, a description of the problem, and two photos showing the defect. We'll reply within two business days with a decision on repair, replacement, or store credit.

Until you hear back, we'd recommend not climbing on the harness.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
